content: {"episode_id":"ep-05035","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient presents with exertional dyspnea and palpitations in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I25.10, I34.0).
